hypothesis: At least one explicitly scoped SuperIndex representation fits the 1600x2000 surface and 500000-byte PNG budget without concealing dependencies.

candidates.decoder: glyphcalc byte decoder plus zlib plus JSON
glyphcalc byte decoder plus external payload resolved by SHA-256

pass: A candidate passes its declared scope only when both surface and PNG budgets pass; dependencies must remain explicit.
fail: No candidate passes both budgets in its declared scope.
non_claims: A failed candidate does not prove that every SuperIndex representation fails.
A referenced candidate does not prove self-contained compression.
Mathematical distinguishability does not establish perceptual safety.
